plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Gnarled branches still bare of leaves burst into fragrant blossoms with delicate, papery petals. The flowers scent the cold air of late winter and are often seen against lingering snow. They are among the first signs that spring is coming.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late January to March, peaking in February in milder parts of Japan
plants.location: Japan, including Kanto and Kansai, where ume groves and shrine gardens are in flower
plants.funFact: Ume blossoms have been celebrated in East Asian poetry and art for more than a thousand years. They were admired in Japan before cherry blossoms became the favorite spring flower.

plants.name: Acacia pycnantha
plants.description: This Australian tree is covered in fluffy, golden pom-pom flowers that give off a honeyed scent. Its curved, leaf-like foliage sets off the bright blooms.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to spring in southern Australia. Flowering usually begins in July and runs through October. This is not a February bloomer, so treat it as outside the date.
plants.funFact: Golden wattle is Australia's national floral emblem. National Wattle Day is celebrated on September 1.

plants.name: Cyclamen coum
plants.description: Small, swept-back petals rise on slender stems above marbled, silver-patterned leaves. The flowers appear in cold weather and form carpets of color in woodland gardens, often alongside snowdrops.
plants.bloomingSeason: Midwinter to early spring, from about December to March, with peak flowering in February
plants.location: Native to the Black Sea region, Turkey and the Caucasus. It is widely grown in temperate gardens in Europe and North America.
plants.funFact: After pollination, the flower stalks coil like springs and pull the seed capsules down to the soil.
